gen-gf-oxanium-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible: Atkinson Hyperlegible reads as a plain sans with clipped capitals and a wide-set s that never gets mistaken for anything else. Oxanium is the one for sharp, ruler-straight display lines, while Atkinson Hyperlegible does the quiet, approachable work of being understood.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible-: Oxanium draws its lines in one uninterrupted monoline, with big lowercase and curves that finish in clear daylight. Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono sits beneath as a plain sans with stretched-open spacing, so the two feel like machinery next to a clear voice.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-biryani: Oxanium's uninterrupted monoline strokes give it a commanding, engineered look. It handles the loud display work, while Biryani, a clean sans-serif with a wide eye on every e, keeps small text unclogged and approachable.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-blinker: Blinker reads as a clean sans with lowercase filling most of the height and apertures you can see straight through. Oxanium is best at standing tall and distinctive up top, and Blinker is best at staying approachable underneath it.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-carrois-gothic: Carrois Gothic reads as a modern sans-serif with a high-set x-height and generously opened curves. Oxanium does the commanding part with its thin-free, swell-free stroke, and Carrois Gothic quietly handles everything that needs to be read.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Sharp, big-lowercase, and unmistakably engineered. Carrois Gothic SC, a contemporary sans-serif with clear openings at every curve and capitals nearly matching lowercase height, gives that lines-keep-their-width heading a smooth landing.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-chivo: Oxanium draws true monoline curves that end in clear daylight. Chivo, a sans-serif with its lowercase packed up toward the caps, carries a longer stretch of text with a steady, approachable texture that never tires the eye.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-chocolate-classical-sa: Oxanium brings a drawn-with-a-ruler-and-compass line and a commanding, oversized lowercase. Chocolate Classical Sans answers with a sizable lowercase of its own and a broad-nibbed stroke, so give it a little extra size to let that pen feel show.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-comme: Comme reads smoothly, with no clogged curves and lowercase bodies filling most of the letter height. And Oxanium's w, with no thick or thin strokes anywhere, gives the pair its strongest quality: a modern, drawn-by-machine confidence over a sleek sans.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-cossette-texte: Oxanium's big lowercase and uninterrupted monoline strokes make it feel distinctive and commanding before you read a word. Cossette Texte follows in a plain sans, wide-eyed and prominent.
